scope: Native main-thread commit work and run-loop busy intervals; not input-to-visible or GPU/display delivery
runLoopScope: Inclusive parent Busy spans can contain nested event-tracking waits. The additional metric excludes explicit run-loop waits only; neither measures CPU execution or input latency.
missingEvidence: Clean host comparison; competing developer work or incomplete monitoring

hostMonitor.scope: One-second developer-process samples; short tasks and other system contention may be missed
